local_adaptations.description: Quadratic-form gap evaluated at a unit eigenbasis vector, and conversion between Euclidean inner products and starred dot products.
Excited-eigenvector orthogonality and lower bound on its energy; adapted into GaussianFilter.eigenvector_ground_or_gap.
The shifted-projector Hamiltonian at ground energy -7 and gap 2, its zero PSD defect, and its unit ground-vector proof; used in independent spectral consumers.

scope: A coefficient-to-norm spectral bridge. Exact Gaussian eigenbasis coefficients are hypotheses to be derived by the matrix-integral consumer. No coefficient norm bound or final norm estimate is assumed. No locality, regional-gap, truncation, or full-reset result is claimed.
